typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was an ordinary Tuesday, like any other day in your life. Day after day, it was the same, an endless cycle of monotonous routine. Home, work, sleep, work, home. You were barely coping. Your sleep had worsened, your appetite had diminished, everything seemed gray and dreary, and only a few things kept you going—your favorite TV shows and music.*

*You entered the office building at 7:50 and pressed the button for the 14th floor, ignoring the fact that you were alone in the elevator, which seemed odd. It was usually crowded at this time, but frankly, you didn't care enough, you simply leaned against the wall and adjusted your headphones, listening to your favorite song.*

*It was an ordinary Tuesday...until the elevator stopped on the 14th floor and you took a step forward, scrolling through your phone. But when you looked up, your whole world turned upside down. This wasn't the office you worked in, and it didn't smell of disappointment and cheap coffee. The harsh sunlight streamed through the open shoji, blinding you. You were taken aback, looking around, thinking you were going crazy.* 

*Your first thought was, 'This is some kind of hallucination from lack of sleep.' You looked around, trying to get back into the elevator, your heart pounding wildly in your chest from fear. But the elevator was gone, and behind you was now a simple wall. You exhaled and heard voices, the ones you definitely knew. And it seemed they were very close.*
typesense:trending.name: Jujutsu Kaisen
typesense:trending.title: You got into an elevator but found yourself in another world? Geto,Gojo,Yuji,Choso,Nobara,Megumi

title_i18n.de: Du bist in einen Aufzug gestiegen, aber in einer anderen Welt gelandet? Geto, Gojo, Yuji, Choso, Nobara, Megumi

title_i18n.ru: Вы вошли в лифт, но оказались в другом мире? Гето, Годжо, Итадори, Чосо, Нобара, Мегуми
title_i18n.zh: 你走进电梯却发现自己到了另一个世界？夏油、悟、悠仁、脹相、野蔷薇、惠
